length_limits.notes: Manuscripts can be any length: no restriction on word count, figure count, or supporting information. Software articles are under 3,500 words. The author summary is 150 to 200 words.

figure_spec.notes: Width 789 to 2,250 pixels and height at most 2,625 pixels, both at 300 dpi. Text inside a figure is Arial, Times or Symbol at 8 to 12 point.

reference_style.style: Vancouver (ICMJE), numbered in citation-sequence order, in-text numbers in square brackets

submission_steps: one compiled PDF of text and figures at initial submission
a cover letter uploaded separately, addressing suitability and impact
an Academic Editor may be suggested

template.notes: Sample formatting PDFs only; no fillable Word or LaTeX manuscript template was found.

license_of_summary_source.statement: PLOS is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) corporation; the page links its Privacy Policy and Terms of Use and references the CC BY publishing policy, whose exact footer wording was not captured.
